findings.highlight: "Your hair is beautiful. It pains me to see it getting so dirty."
findings.evidenceJa: 「その髪は美しい。目の前で汚れてしまうのは、いささか心苦しいというものでしょう」
findings.governingReading: She prevents impending hair contamination by wiping Illya's mouth, and explains that witnessing beautiful hair get spoiled would be painful.
findings.explanation: Distress at beautiful hair becoming dirty becomes seeing hair already so dirty.
